basic_info.description: Experience breathtaking views in this spacious 3-4 bedroom condo in a well-maintained boutique 3-unit building with low HOA dues in Russian Hill. Ideally located near the Marina, North Beach, and Ghirardelli Square, this charming home overlooks Angel Island, the Bay, and Alcatraz from the kitchen, dining, and living room.  Step onto the outdoor patio deck to soak in the stunning views. The living room features a cozy fireplace, while an in-unit washer/dryer, deeded parking, and a sizable storage room add convenience.  With postcard-perfect views, an unbeatable location, and low HOA dues, enjoy the best of San Francisco living.
